subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: Should WhatsApp reactions be exposed as a generic `message reactions` query, as opt-in plugin/system events, as durable historical state, or as a narrower hook-only feature first?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable storage, privacy, agent-visibility, hook/config, and historical-query semantics are product/API choices that should not be guessed by an automated fix lane.

options.title: Design the complete read surface first
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad canonical item and ask for a maintainer-approved design covering query, events, storage, privacy, and docs before implementation.

options.title: Split into narrower tracked slices
options.body: Use this issue to link smaller canonical issues for `message reactions`, `reaction_received` hooks, and reaction-triggered turns, then close only after the broad request is decomposed.

options.title: Limit to hook-only support
options.body: Intentionally support only an opt-in plugin hook and leave generic CLI historical reaction queries out of scope for now.

recommendation.title: Design the complete read surface first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad canonical item and ask for a maintainer-approved design covering query, events, storage, privacy, and docs before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged WhatsApp reaction/action work is closest to the affected action, runtime, and approval-reaction surfaces.
